evidence: DECISION: serve USEFFR from 2016-03-01 (keep registry history_start). The API has EFFR from 2000-07-03, but rows before 2016-03-01 are the OLD brokered-trades methodology (schema carries intraDayLow/intraDayHigh/stdDeviation); from 2016-03-01 the NY Fed computes EFFR as the volume-weighted MEDIAN of FR 2420 data (schema carries percentPercentile1..99 + volumeInBillions) -- live fixtures effr_search_2016-02-25_2016-03-03.json shows the switch on exactly 2016-03-01. One series must not splice two methodologies. The long history (1954-) exists on the Board's H.15 as RIFSPFF_N.B via fed_ddp (identical values from 2016-03-01; verification/nyfed.txt section 4) if a long-history series is wanted later.
Rows before 2008-12-16 carry NO targetRateTo (single target regime); the adapter skips rows lacking the field and floors at this date (same as history_start).

Before 2008-12-16 targetRateFrom holds the POINT target (2008-12-15: 1.00 with no targetRateTo) -- a different concept than the range floor; the floor prevents splicing it in (fixture effr_search_2008-12-10_2008-12-22.json).
